title: Solo melee hit that kills the foe
description: The engine resolves a won attack and the foe drops. The narration must not revive it, must name the goblin the player attacked, and the summary must keep the engine's roll line.
player_input: I attack the goblin with my shortsword.

play.consequence_planner.mechanical_summary: Lyra attacks the goblin with a shortsword (d20 rolled 15 + 5 = 20 vs AC 13 -> success). The hit deals 6 damage and the goblin drops.

scripted.play.narrator: Your shortsword finds the goblin's ribs. It staggers, drops its blade and falls still in the mud. The passage ahead is quiet now. What do you do next?
